chunks: Verily God knows the unknown of the heavens and the earth. Indeed He knows what lies in the hearts of men.

key_terms.ذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ: The inner essence of the chests/hearts

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's knowledge of the unseen and the heart?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine attribute of 'Ilm al-Ghayb' (Knowledge of the Unseen), affirming that God’s awareness extends beyond the physical cosmos to the hidden realities of the heart (Dhat al-Sudur). This comprehensive knowledge serves as the basis for divine justice, ensuring that no inner intention remains concealed from the All-Knowing, a concept central to the doctrine of the Infallibles' perfect awareness.
